bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; renaming the Minnesota Senate Building after Kari Dziedzic; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. KARI DZIEDZIC SENATE BUILDING.

The Minnesota Senate Building located at 95 University Avenue West in the city of St. Paul is renamed as the Kari Dziedzic Senate Building.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; SIGNAGE CHANGES FOR KARI DZIEDZIC SENATE BUILDING.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of administration to replace signs in the Capitol complex to reflect the change of name of the Minnesota Senate Building to the Kari Dziedzic Senate Building, as required in section 1.

Sec. 3. REVISOR INSTRUCTION.

The revisor of statutes must replace "Minnesota Senate Building" with "the Kari Dziedzic Senate Building" wherever it appears in Minnesota Statutes and Minnesota Rules.

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; renaming the Minnesota Senate Building after Kari Dziedzic; specifying signage cost.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. KARI DZIEDZIC SENATE BUILDING.

The Minnesota Senate Building located at 95 University Avenue West in the city of St. Paul is renamed as the Kari Dziedzic Senate Building.

Sec. 2. SIGNAGE COSTS.

The commissioner of administration must pay for the cost of modifying or replacing signage as necessary to conform with section 1 using general fund appropriations available for operations or in lieu of rent under Laws 2025, chapter 39, article 1, section 11. The commissioner must not include these costs in determining lease rates for fiscal years 2028 and 2029 or otherwise pass the cost of signage on to tenants of the building in section 1.

Sec. 3. REVISOR INSTRUCTION.

The revisor of statutes must replace "Minnesota Senate Building" with "the Kari Dziedzic Senate Building" wherever it appears in Minnesota Statutes and Minnesota Rules.
additions: The Minnesota Senate Building located at 95 University Avenue West in the city of St. Paul is renamed as the Kari Dziedzic Senate Building.
